cases.name: the halves met: R1 reads its own side (x2 void for it)
the merge naming y1 and y2, signed by all, stating the fixed roster: concludes
after it R1 reads one roster, and x2 stays void for it (nothing revived)
and R2 reads the same roster
later changes name it: an admission of Z at m, by nine of the eleven, concludes for R1 and R2 alike
one side's merge (A B C D E H K) is refused: on y2 it is five of nine
a side that will not sign: the room stays two rooms for the two reader sets, and each side acts on its own line (side 1 admits Z at y1)
the same read by R2: Z is not on its line
the content is fixed: a merge dropping L (never removed) concludes nothing
nor one adding Z
nor one stating another duty seat (B as moderator too)
a cheap tip that removed A and B (C..G at aG) is not mergeable without the honest tip's count: C..G alone are five of x1's eight
with x1's count too (A B C D E F G H sign; A and B, removed on cr2, are voices on x1 only): it concludes, and the removed stay removed
a member's own end on one tip: D left on side 2 (its end in y2's line); the merge's fixed roster drops D (the room key's end is final)
and a merge re-seating D concludes nothing
a removal on one tip, void for a reader on the other: side 2 removes E; for R1 (at y1) E stays
the merge states the roster outright: E, removed on y2, is out for R1 too (the merge ends the seat its line kept)
a member need not sign the merge: L's seat is its own consent on y2 (all but L sign)
three tips: a merge of x1, x2 and x3, counted on each, states the union
three tips: short on one (x3's members A..G N: four of eight sign) concludes nothing
an infrastructure room: a merge is a founders' amendment on each tip, M (3) of that tip's active founders (five), stating the founders and the nodes: it concludes, and both nodes are seated
short on one tip: f1 and f2 with nothing of side B's but f3 (f1 f2 f3 sign) are three on each: the same; f1 and f2 alone are two: refused
a node never signs or counts: f1, f2 and the nodes are two founders
a merge from a stalled tip concludes nothing: on side B f4 and f5 left, three founders, at most M (the edge: a partition leaving one side at M or fewer founders does not heal by merge)
the word kept: five stated founders, at most N (5): no new word
a new word above N: side A seats f6 (quorum:4/6); six stated founders are above side B's N (5), so the merge states quorum:4/6 (M never lowered)
and keeping the old word with six founders concludes nothing
fewer than M + 1 stated founders is valid (f5 removed on A, f4 left on B: f1 f2 f3), and the merged room is stalled after: a node seating at the merge by f1 f2 f3 concludes nothing
tips in each other's past are no merge: x1 and y1
a merge that leaves out a newest tip concludes nothing: x1 and y2 (y1 newer than x1)
